title: RLS Filter
text: Compute filtered output, filter error, and filter weights for given input and desired signal using RLS adaptive filter algorithm, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Reset port} sets Enable Reset port; {Filter length} sets the length of FIR filter coefficients vector, {Specify forgetting factor via} sets the forgetting factor, {Forgetting factor (0 to 1)} sets the rLS forgetting factor, {Initial value of filter weights} sets the initial value of FIR filter weights, {Initial input variance estimate} sets the initial input covariance estimate, {Adapt port} and {Output filter weights}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Lambda
ports.summary: Forgetting factor scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Adapt
ports.summary: Option to update filter weights scalar | column vector

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: Difference between output and desired signal scalar | column vector

ports.name: Wts
ports.summary: Adaptive filter weights scalar | column vector

params.name: Filter length
params.values: Length of FIR filter coefficients vector 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Specify forgetting factor via
params.values: Specify forgetting factor Dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Forgetting factor (0 to 1)
params.values: RLS forgetting factor 1.0 (default) | scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Initial value of filter weights
params.values: Initial value of FIR filter weights 0 (default) | vector

params.name: Initial input variance estimate
params.values: Initial input covariance estimate 0.1 (default) | scalar | square matrix

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Enable Reset port None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample
